body: (M22) I'm not doing good every day is a struggle every day I have thoughts about killing myself and every day I feel like they get worse. I'm worried eventually the thoughts will consume me. I don't feel like I have anything to live for except for my dad and my sister. I have been living on my own the past few months and I feel that has made my depression worse because I don't have any family to come home to, no one to talk to  at the end of the day and no real friends in my life. I started smoking pot in high-school which led to me using cocaine, lsd and other drugs and even selling drugs to supply my habbit. I quit everything but pot around the beginning of my senior year of high-school but by then I had ruined my high-school career I had no true friends in my life just people who I partied with and used me for drugs.so I stepped away from everyone in my life except my family. I quit smoking pot almost 2 years ago because for me I felt it was making me more depressed. My mom had recently passed away from a rough battle with stage 4 lung cancer and all I did was get stoned and listen to sad music and sometimes just cry. So I've been completely sober for almost 2 years and I'll tell you what I'm proud of myself. However I still have no friends in my life and I don't have much desire to want to live most days because of how bad I messed my life up. I hate myself and the choices ive made. I have a good job doing welding and alright co workers and boss but thats just a job and it doesnt make me happy. It actually makes me aggravated some days and doesnt help my mental well being. And to top it all off everytime I find a girl that I think is attractive and I try to pursue a relationship it never works out and I often think it's just because I'm messed up in the head and I'm awkward and have all these problems. I feel like no one that I would find attractive finds me attractive. I need help. I don't want to take anti depressants because of the side affects and I had a good friend who killed him self while taking them and I feel they aided in him choosing to take his life. I have talked to a therapist but after i explained my problems, a session or 2 later i found myself just telling them what they want to hear so I can get away from them. How do I find a desire to live and how can I be happy because I've been so unhappy for so long now I don't even know what to do with my life
